[pre]The Gendarmite Harold | Daily Bird | Fox News [/pre] 

[b][February.1.2025][/b]

[i]The border between Gendarme and Bravanor remained silent, fear and tension filled the atmosphere of both sides. Today was the day, that the Gendarmites would begin their first action to secure victory against the Bravanorians. Admiral Étienne Leclerc had begun the ordering of a planned preemptive strike to knockout the Bravanorians before they could ever strike. The prior day was filled with battery strikes that mainly targeted Bravanorian infrastructure and military logisitics, reports of success of these strikes were still undetermined. Gendarmite Strategic defense forces reported shooting down multiple Bravanorian reconnaissance drones that were attempting to capture Intel of Gendarmite military installations and infrastrucutre.[/i]

[b]INVASION OF SOUTHERN JUANE[/b]

[i]A soldier exited his trench, today would be the day the war officially started. Colonelle Isabelle Dufresne had ordered all soldiers to rally at the commanding station to begin the operation. As the soldier exited his trench, he'd notice the rancid smell of overripe meat within one of the quarters of his comrades. This stench wouldn't be the most pleasing thing to wake up to but he had to keep going, running on only 4 hours of sleep his body felt numb. After a short ten minute commute to the General Quarters of the trench system, the soldier would open a door revealing Isabelle's living quarters. "[b]You're on time.[/b]" Isabelle would comment, she was a young, beautiful, woman. What was such an individual doing here? Ordering men to their deaths on a hot, dense, stinky island that was prone to mosquitoes in the summer time. She was the younger sister of the newly proclaimed Capricornian governor Admiral Étienne Leclerc, he gave her complete control of the Juane fighting force after he departed back to Alicia to regroup and revise his army. "[b]Forgive me madam, the conditions here are terrible, I was awoken by the buzzing of mosquitoes![/b]"  The soldier would reply, bowing down before the small woman as gesture of admiration, but she was having none of it. "[b]Maybe you should be woken up by the screaming of your comrades fighting at the front because you were too damn lazy to get the hell out of bed![/b]" she jeered his remarks. "[b]I'm so-[/b]" "[b]Get the hell out of my office!, all of you should be ready within 20 minutes! If I catch any of you maggots trying to escape the fighting, I'll personally kick your face in![/b]" The soldier immediately ran out the room in distress, he really was going to die on a tropical hell-hole.[/i]

[i][u]20 MINUTES LATER[/u]
[/i]
[i]The soldier reached his post, he was a part of the 1ère Section de Choc(1st Shock Section), a jungle specialized platoon consisting of 40 soldiers, and 2 AMX-10RC light tanks. The 1ère Section de Choc was one of 50 different platoons that were apart of the Brigade de Choc de la République(Shock Brigade of the Republic) which was instructed to commence the invasion of Bravanorian occupied Juane. He and his comrades were to take an uncharted route that would lead them straight to the Bravanorian border in under an hour. As the sixth hour of the day approached, the soldier and his army would venture out into the dense jungles of Juane to engage the enemy. 

The soldier took the current downtime to get the much needed sleep that he would require to survive the war zone. "[b]Wake the hell up![/b]" the demand of his comrade jolted the soldier awake. After rubbing his eyes for a couple moments the soldier would see a tall, stocky man infront of him. The sight of such an intimidating individual frightened him, if he was this scared of his own comrades how did he expect to survive against people who are actually trying to kill him? The soldier thought to himself, little did he know, his sudden blanking out infuriated the soldier even more as his giant hands grabbed him by the collar.  "[b]Please!, pardon me of my incompetence! I have fought in a war before, nor have I ever killed a man!. [/b]" the boy begged, "[b]Oh you won't be the one doing the killing alright. Keep acting like such a p*ssy and you'll have a 2 inch crater straight in your forehead! It'd be best for me to kill you now, and not have to worry about them capturing and milking your fragile ass for information because you know too damn much yet do too little!"[/b] the giant wrapped his hands around the soldier's neck before suddenly constricting over it, the boy felt as if he was going to die right here, by the hands of a comrade, who could pardon themselves by accusing the soldier that he had conspired to defect. As the light started fading away the soldier would see a hand pat the giant's back. Instantly, he let go of the soldier. As the soldier regurgitated air back into his lungs, he could see a short figure jeering the man who had almost killed him. The figure had what seemed to be multiple war badges on his chest, a sign that he was to be treated with the utmost respect. As the man turned his focus from the giant, he moved towards the fallen soldier and opened a hand. "[b]Welcome to the army.[/b]"[/i]
[b]_____________________[/b]

[b]Juane News Station, Villemontier, Juane Island.[/b]

[i]"[b]Are we live?[/b]" the news reporter asked, the cameraman raised his thumb approving of her question. The news reporter sighed before focusing her attention on the camera, "[b]Good morning citizens of Juane!,  this is the Daily Bird in Juane giving you the latest and most unbiased news information on the current crisis between Gendarme and the Étrangère(Foreign powers)! Currently, a border conflict has escalated to full-scale war between the Commonwealth of Gendarme and the Imperio of Bravanor. All citizens residing in southern Juane have been evacuated and we strongly recommend that any civilian still residing within Juane follow evacuation procedures to ensure that they are safe. The Gendarmite Commonwealth has amended a policy to give civilians displaced by the conflict free residence within Alicia to support its growing population and industry! Ahead of that now, a lot of information has been released on the current state of the war. Gendarmite officials claim that the Capricornian army has made several advances within Bravanorian occupied territory within Southern Gendarme. These claims have been backed with hundreds of photos and videos of Gendarmite flags being waved on nearby villages in Bravanor. [/b]" The reporting transitions to a blurred video of Gendarmite troops storming a village. "[b]While we try our best to receive the most trustworthy unbiased information, such events like these need time to marinate before accurate reporting can be held. That sums it up for today, this is the Daily Bird, your unbiased news network.[/b]" the screen would cut off therefore ending the reporting. [/i][/spoiler]
I am NOT late to the party.
There was a party?
